title: msms-controls: two controls for attributing gains in MS/MS spectral-representation studies
description:
A rounding control and a conditioning-parity check for experiments that compare peak-level MS/MS models against binned baselines.

The rounding control quantises the mass axis inside the peak-token pipeline, so the spectral representation can be varied while the encoder is held fixed; a two-arm comparison otherwise moves both at once. The conditioning-parity check asserts that every arm of an ablation actually responds to the acquisition metadata it was given, a failure that is silent and that halved the headline result of the study this package was extracted from.

Pure numpy. Supporting software for Pan X, Wang C, A metadata-matched binned baseline halves the apparent peak-level advantage in MS/MS substructure prediction.
